content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Irving

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and measurable project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour requirements for your background—typically a secondary degree plus documented project-leadership hours, or equivalent professional experience. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can clarify whether you meet the baseline to enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Instruction
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Over a structured program, you'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world application, and exam strategy. All sessions are delivered online, so you can complete your coursework while maintaining your professional schedule in Irving's competitive job market.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application and Fee
steps_items.text: After finishing your bootcamp coursework, formally apply through PMI's credential portal. You'll document your education, experience, and references for PMI's review process. Once approved, submit your exam fee to schedule your testing window—your gateway to sitting for the PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides targeted exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and study guidance to reinforce bootcamp content. You'll sit for the computer-based PMP exam, which assesses your mastery of project-management domains and your readiness to lead complex initiatives in your industry.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification requires renewal every three years through professional development units (PDUs). Plan to earn PDUs via continuing education, conference attendance, volunteer project leadership, or advanced training. Staying current keeps your credential active and demonstrates ongoing commitment to project-management excellence.
